plan.note: GPU smoke test (docs/EXPAB_PLAN.md section 6): 20 development questions per model and mode, the chooser arms, B (debate + alone, 10 disputed panels per mode), the judge confirmation (10 events, 10 own-answer questions), a like-for-like vLLM-vs-HF sanity check on 20 judge questions, then the HF readouts. Tagged 'smoke' so no part name collides with the real runs. The thinking bank and B use the visible rationale (D1, on by default); a variant WITHOUT it (tag smokenovis) on the same 20 questions measures the answer-cap rate of both. qwen_t answer cap 700. Steps grouped by model (one vLLM process per model, one HF process) so each model loads once. Attempt 2 (after the attempt-1 OOM): trimmed to 10 questions per model and mode, 5 B panels per mode, 5 judge events, 10 sanity questions, to fit the remaining cap.
